**Node.js 22.0.0 GitHub release**

1. **[nodejs/node v22.0.0 release](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0)** — Official GitHub release page. Released 24 Apr 2024 by RafaelGSS (with @marco-ippolito). Tag `v22.0.0`, commit `12fb157`, signed. Status at release: Current (LTS planned for October). Highlights: `require()` of synchronous ESM graphs, WebSocket client, V8 updates. [[1]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0) [[1]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0)

2. **Notable changes on that page** — Drop import assertions (#52104); faster AbortSignal creation (#52408); `watch` marked stable (#52074); V8 updated to 12.4.254.14 (#52465); WebSocket enabled by default (#51594); higher default stream `highWaterMark` (#52037); Maglev enabled on supported arches (#51360); `node --run` (#52190); `fs.glob` / `globSync` (#51912); experimental `require()` of sync ESM (#51977). [[1]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0)

3. **Release notes source on GitHub** — Same notes in the nodejs.org repo: [v22.0.0.md](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org/blob/main/apps/site/pages/en/blog/release/v22.0.0.md) (author Rafael Gonzaga, date 2024-04-24). Includes binaries, SHASUMS, and docs links. [[2]](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org/blob/main/apps/site/pages/en/blog/release/v22.0.0.md)

4. **Node.js 22 changelog** — [CHANGELOG_V22.md](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/changelogs/CHANGELOG_V22.md) (also raw). Codename later “Jod”; `22.0.0` is the first entry in the 22.x series. [[3]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/changelogs/CHANGELOG_V22.md) [[4]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/raw/main/doc/changelogs/CHANGELOG_V22.md)

5. **Changelog directory** — [doc/changelogs](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tree/master/doc/changelogs) on `nodejs/node`. [[5]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tree/master/doc/changelogs)

6. **Announcement (nodejs.org, not GitHub)** — [Node.js 22 is now available!](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/announcements/v22-release-announce) points at the full release post and download page; notes V8 12.4 (Wasm GC, `Array.fromAsync`, Set methods, iterator helpers) and `--experimental-require-module`. [[6]](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/announcements/v22-release-announce)

7. **Lineage / support context** — Node.js 22 first released 24 Apr 2024 (codename Jod). endoflife.date lists security support through 30 Apr 2027; latest listed 22.x is well past 22.0.0. [[7]](https://endoflife.date/nodejs) [[8]](https://nodejs.org/en/about/previous-releases)

8. **All tags** — [nodejs/node tags](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tags) includes later 22.x tags (e.g. v22.23.3); v22.0.0 is the initial 22 release, not the current 22.x build. [[9]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tags)
